scripts.build: yarn check-schema-drift && yarn extract-defaults && yarn build-local-deps && shx rm -rf dist && tsc -b && yarn copy-schema
scripts.build-dev: node scripts/generate-tflm-schema.js && yarn workspace cfs-plugins-sdk build && yarn check-schema-drift && yarn copy-schema && tsc -b --watch
scripts.build-local-deps: node scripts/generate-tflm-schema.js && yarn ws:plugins-sdk build && yarn ws:pkg-mgr build && yarn ws:ccm-lib build
scripts.copy-schema: shx mkdir -p dist/types/schemas && shx cp src/types/schemas/*.json dist/types/schemas/
scripts.test: node scripts/generate-tflm-schema.js && yarn extract-defaults && c8 mocha test/**/*.test.ts --reporter-option output=coverage/test-results.json
